question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for ‘refuse’ in the given sentence.

Shama was allowed to visit the accommodation places for the devotees of the shrine.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Allow**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"refuse"** means to indicate or show that one is not willing to do something. (इनकार करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite the cold weather, he refused to wear a coat.
 
 

 
• **"Allow"** refers to giving permission for something to happen or agreeing to let someone do something; it is the opposite of refusing. (अनुमति देना)

 
 
• **Example: **The company allows employees to work from home on Fridays.
